title: Extension of prism horns with invertible vertical edges
statement: Use simplicial sets, horns and equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $Q$ be a quasicategory, $A\subseteq B$ a simplicial subset, and $n\geq2$. Suppose $h:(A\times\Delta^n)\cup(B\times\Lambda_0^n)\to Q$ is a simplicial map such that, for every vertex $b$ of $B$, its restriction to $\{b\}\times[0,1]$ is an equivalence. Then $h$ extends to $B\times\Delta^n$. No finiteness assumption on $B$ or invertibility assumption on its edges is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 4.4.4.8, specialized to the inner fibration Q → Δ⁰. The original allows an arbitrary inner fibration and a prescribed base diagram; neither additional generality is needed here.
